cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/spec-update.patch
--- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
+++ specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
@@ -28,3 +28,6 @@
 - The `catch` gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error` ([chatOrchestrator.ts#L161](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts#L161)), so a rejection that is not an `Error` — a thrown string or object — bypasses `onError` entirely while still propagating to the caller.
 - `afterModelResponse` is called once per user message after the round loop exits and receives the summed provider-call usage for the entire turn, so tool rounds are included in a deployer's billing or audit total ([validated by: reports the summed usage from every provider call in a turn with two tool rounds](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L44)).
+- It ignores rounds without usage when summing across multiple provider rounds ([validated by: sums usage across multiple provider rounds, ignoring rounds without usage](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L256)).
+- It counts reported rounds while leaving a turn with no reported usage undefined ([validated by: counts reported rounds while leaving a turn with no reported usage undefined](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts#L67)).
+- It preserves undefined when no rounds report usage ([validated by: preserves undefined when no rounds report usage](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts#L289)).
EOF
